messages.content: Selamat pagi. Saya Siti Nur, change manager NetOps TM Unifi Cyberjaya. Saya nak propose satu change request — firmware upgrade untuk OLT cluster di Penang region, total 14 OLT, dari V8.2.1 ke V8.4.0. Vendor cadangkan 4 jam window pada Sabtu malam (24 Mei 2026, 11pm). Affected subs around 38,000 BTU. Boleh tolong buka change request?
Selamat pagi Puan Siti Nur, terima kasih kerana menghubungi Change Governance Desk. Saya akan buka change request untuk firmware upgrade OLT cluster Penang sekarang. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.name: propose_change_request
function.arguments: {"title": "OLT Cluster Penang Firmware Upgrade V8.2.1 -> V8.4.0", "description": "Vendor-recommended firmware upgrade for 14 OLTs in Penang region to address known CVE-2026-0118 and improve ONT registration stability. ~38,000 BTU subs in scope, planned 4-hour maintenance window 24 May 2026 23:00 MYT.", "requested_by": {"user_id": "snur-cm-08", "role": "change_manager", "team": "netops_access"}, "change_type": "standard", "change_category": "firmware_upgrade", "governance": {"impact_level": "medium", "customer_impact_estimate": {"subscribers_affected": 38000, "region": "Penang"}, "vendor_recommended": true, "linked_security_ref": "CVE-2026-0118"}}

messages.name: propose_change_request
messages.content: {"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0421", "status": "draft", "created_at": "2026-05-21T08:30:11+08:00", "reference_number": "CR-NETOPS-2026-0421", "next_required_steps": ["perform_impact_and_risk_assessment", "validate_change_policy_compliance"]}

Change request dibuka, Puan.

- **Change ID:** `chg-2026-05-0421`
- **Reference:** `CR-NETOPS-2026-0421`
- Status: draft

Langkah seterusnya: impact & risk assessment dan semakan kepatuhan polisi. Adakah Puan mahu saya teruskan kedua-duanya serentak?

Yes proceed. Impact scope: 14 OLTs di Penang access ring 03 dan 04, kira-kira 38k subs BTU. Risk inputs: rollback boleh dilakukan dalam 30 minit, vendor sokongan standby, dan kita ada change yang sama untuk Kedah dua minggu lepas berjaya.
Baik Puan. Saya jalankan impact assessment dan policy validation serentak.

messages.content: {"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0421", "assessment_id": "asmt-77821", "computed_risk_level": "medium", "risk_score": 48, "residual_risk": "low", "impact_summary": {"subscribers_affected": 38000, "service_credit_estimate_myr": 12500, "downtime_window_minutes": 240}, "recommendations": ["require_l2_approval", "schedule_outside_peak_hours", "customer_advance_notice_72h"]}

messages.name: validate_change_policy_compliance
messages.content: {"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0421", "compliant": true, "matched_policies": [{"policy_id": "pol-cab-l2-fw", "verdict": "compliant", "note": "L2 CAB approval required for >10k subs impacted"}, {"policy_id": "pol-blackout-penang-haji", "verdict": "compliant", "note": "Window outside Haji blackout (4-12 June)"}, {"policy_id": "pol-customer-notification-72h", "verdict": "non_compliant", "note": "Window 24 May 23:00; 72h notice would require notification by 21 May 23:00"}]}

Hasil, Puan:

**Impact & Risk Assessment (`asmt-77821`)**
- Risk level: **Medium** (score 48)
- Subs terjejas: 38,000 / Downtime: 240 minit
- Service credit estimate: RM 12,500
- Saranan: L2 approval diperlukan; window di luar peak; notis pelanggan 72 jam

**Policy Compliance**
- L2 CAB approval: COMPLIANT
- Haji blackout (4-12 Jun): COMPLIANT — change Sabtu 24 Mei masih sebelum
- **Notifikasi pelanggan 72 jam: NON-COMPLIANT** — perlu hantar notis sebelum 21 Mei 11pm (iaitu malam ini)

Kita mesti hantar notis pelanggan malam ini. Adakah Puan mahu saya juga semak konflik change window dengan kalendar berjadual sekarang?
Yes check window conflicts untuk 24 Mei 11pm - 25 Mei 3am di region Penang. Sambil tu, attach evidence vendor release note V8.4.0 sebagai sokongan.
Baik Puan. Saya periksa konflik tetingkap dan lampirkan release note serentak.

messages.content: {"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0421", "candidate_window": {"start": "2026-05-24T23:00:00+08:00", "end": "2026-05-25T03:00:00+08:00"}, "conflicts": [{"conflict_change_id": "chg-2026-05-0399", "title": "BRAS Penang firmware patch", "window": {"start": "2026-05-25T01:00:00+08:00", "end": "2026-05-25T02:30:00+08:00"}, "overlap_minutes": 90, "severity": "high", "reason": "shared upstream BRAS may cause double-impact for OLT-PNG-AR04"}], "recommendation": "shift_window_or_coordinate"}

messages.name: attach_change_evidence
messages.content: {"evidence_id": "evid-77821-rn", "change_id": "chg-2026-05-0421", "name": "Vendor Release Note V8.4.0", "attached_at": "2026-05-21T08:42:08+08:00", "storage_url": "s3://tm-change-evidence/chg-2026-05-0421/release-notes-v8.4.0.pdf"}

Hasil, Puan:

**Konflik tetingkap terdeteksi:**
- Change `chg-2026-05-0399` (BRAS Penang firmware patch) bertindih **90 minit** (25 Mei 1:00-2:30 pagi)
- Severity: HIGH — BRAS upstream berkongsi dengan OLT-PNG-AR04, risiko impak berganda
- Saranan: anjak tetingkap atau koordinasi

**Evidence dilampirkan:** `evid-77821-rn` (release notes V8.4.0)

Saya cadangkan anjak tetingkap kita ke 25 Mei 3am-7am supaya tidak bertindih. Atau koordinasi dengan team BRAS. Bagaimana Puan?

Anjak ke 25 Mei 3am-7am je. Schedule window baru tu. Lepas tu simulate execution untuk new window — saya nak lihat side effect plan dan urutan langkah. Bookmark previous CR `chg-2026-05-0218` Kedah sebagai precedent.
Baik Puan. Saya jadualkan tetingkap baru dan simulasi pelaksanaan serentak.

function.arguments: {"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0421", "requested_window": {"start": "2026-05-25T03:00:00+08:00", "end": "2026-05-25T07:00:00+08:00", "timezone": "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur", "region": "Penang"}, "justification": "Shifted to avoid 90-minute overlap with chg-2026-05-0399 (BRAS Penang)", "precedent_change_id": "chg-2026-05-0218"}

messages.name: simulate_change_execution
messages.content: {"simulation_id": "sim-cg-77821", "change_id": "chg-2026-05-0421", "projected_duration_minutes": 215, "step_breakdown": [{"step": "snapshot_olt_config", "duration_minutes": 12, "batches": 4}, {"step": "upload_firmware_image", "duration_minutes": 18, "batches": 4}, {"step": "upgrade_in_batches", "duration_minutes": 145, "batches": 4, "subscriber_impact_per_batch": 9500}, {"step": "verify_ont_registration", "duration_minutes": 30}, {"step": "smoke_test_traffic", "duration_minutes": 10}], "side_effects": ["ont_re_registration_burst", "radius_aaa_authentication_spike"], "buffer_minutes_remaining": 25, "verdict": "feasible"}

Sangat baik, Puan:

- **Tetingkap baru:** `win-77821-a` — **25 Mei 2026, 3am-7am MYT**. Konflik `chg-2026-05-0399` diselesaikan.

**Simulasi (`sim-cg-77821`)** — feasible
- Anggaran 215 minit (buffer 25 minit dalam 240-minit window)
- 4 batch OLT upgrade, ~9,500 subs per batch
- Side effects: ONT re-registration burst, RADIUS AAA spike — perlu prepare AAA capacity

Adakah Puan ingin saya hantar untuk L2 CAB approval sekarang?

Yes submit for approval — chain CAB Manager, Head of NetOps, dengan justification "Vendor recommended firmware with CVE fix, prior Kedah change succeeded, BRAS conflict resolved." Deadline approval 23 Mei 6pm supaya sempat hantar customer notification.
Baik Puan. Saya hantar untuk L2 approval.

function.arguments: {"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0421", "approval_chain": [{"step_name": "cab_manager", "approver_role": "cab_manager", "min_approvers": 1}, {"step_name": "head_of_netops", "approver_role": "head_of_netops", "min_approvers": 1}], "justification": "Vendor recommended firmware with CVE-2026-0118 fix, prior Kedah change (chg-2026-05-0218) succeeded, BRAS conflict resolved via window shift to 25 May 03:00-07:00 MYT."}

Approval request dihantar, Puan.

- **Approval ID:** `appr-cg-77821`
- CAB Manager (`cab-mgr-ravi-04`) — pending
- Head of NetOps (`hno-wong-02`) — menunggu giliran
- **Deadline:** 23 Mei 6pm

Adakah Puan mahu saya snapshot state semasa change ini, dan subscribe ke event lifecycle agar team Penang dapat update auto?
Yes both — snapshot dengan purpose 'pre_approval_baseline' dan subscribe events untuk approved, started, completed, failed, rolled_back. Hantar ke Slack webhook NetOps Penang.
Baik Puan. Saya snapshot dan subscribe serentak.

Selesai, Puan.

- **Snapshot:** `snap-cg-77821-001` (kekal 90 hari)
- **Subscription:** `sub-cg-77821-png` — 5 event types ke Slack NetOps Penang

Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang Puan perlukan sementara menunggu approval?
Boleh — tunjuk saya list semua change yang masih in_manual_review atau awaiting_approval di region Penang last 14 days. Saya nak buat audit kecil untuk team weekly review.
Sudah tentu, Puan. Saya senaraikan change yang berkaitan.

messages.content: {"total_count": 7, "items": [{"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0421", "title": "OLT Cluster Penang Firmware Upgrade V8.2.1 -> V8.4.0", "status": "awaiting_approval", "created_at": "2026-05-21T08:30:11+08:00"}, {"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0399", "title": "BRAS Penang firmware patch", "status": "awaiting_approval", "created_at": "2026-05-20T10:12:00+08:00"}, {"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0312", "title": "Add new transport DWDM ring Penang-Butterworth", "status": "in_manual_review", "created_at": "2026-05-15T14:05:00+08:00"}, {"change_id": "chg-2026-05-0287", "title": "Penang core router HA failover validation", "status": "awaiting_approval", "created_at": "2026-05-13T08:00:00+08:00"}], "facets": [{"field": "change_category", "buckets": [{"key": "firmware_upgrade", "count": 3}, {"key": "network_expansion", "count": 2}, {"key": "failover_test", "count": 2}]}, {"field": "status", "buckets": [{"key": "awaiting_approval", "count": 5}, {"key": "in_manual_review", "count": 2}]}]}

Hasil pencarian, Puan — 7 change aktif di Penang dalam 14 hari terakhir:

| Change | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `chg-2026-05-0421` | OLT Penang FW V8.4.0 (kita) | awaiting_approval |
| `chg-2026-05-0399` | BRAS Penang FW patch | awaiting_approval |
| `chg-2026-05-0312` | DWDM ring Penang-Butterworth | in_manual_review |
| `chg-2026-05-0287` | Core router HA failover | awaiting_approval |

5 awaiting_approval, 2 in_manual_review. Kategori paling aktif: firmware_upgrade (3). Adakah Puan mahu sesuatu lagi?

Update petang. CAB Manager ravi-04 dah approve, head of NetOps wong-02 pun dah approve. Boleh record kedua-dua approval, lepas tu evaluate change policies sekali lagi sebagai final gate sebelum implementation kick-off Sabtu malam.
Baik Puan. Saya rekod kedua-dua keputusan dan nilai polisi sebagai final gate.

Semua gate lulus, Puan:

- **Approval:** 2/2 — overall_status `approved` (CAB Manager 3:11pm, Head of NetOps 3:15pm pada 23 Mei)
- **Policy final gate:** all_gates_passed
  - Notification 72h: COMPLIANT (dihantar 21 Mei 5pm)
  - Window compliance: COMPLIANT
- **Ready for implementation:** YES

Adakah Puan mahu saya mulakan implementation pada window yang dijadual (25 Mei 3am), atau Puan akan trigger manual semasa shift NOC?
Start implementation sekarang — assume 25 Mei dah masuk 3am. Sambil tu add comment yang summarize keseluruhan approval trail untuk audit reference.
Baik Puan. Saya mulakan implementation dan rekod komen audit serentak.

Implementation bermula, Puan.

- **Implementation ID:** `impl-77821`
- Status: in_progress (snapshot_olt_config)
- Started: 25 Mei 3:00 pagi
- 4 batch dirancang (4+4+3+3 OLT)
- **Audit comment:** `cmt-77821-009` direkodkan

Slack webhook NetOps Penang akan menerima event update secara langsung. Adakah Puan mahu saya pantau progress?
Pantau status — 30 minit lepas. Lepas tu, get full audit trail untuk handover NOC shift pagi.
Sudah tentu, Puan. Saya semak status dan dapatkan audit trail serentak.

Update Puan:

**Status implementation**
- Step semasa: `upgrade_in_batches`, batch `b2`
- Batch `b1` SELESAI (9,500 subs sudah re-register normally)
- Anggaran siap: 25 Mei **6:35 pagi** (dalam buffer window)
- Tiada warning

**Audit trail** — 8 event direkodkan dari proposal (21 Mei 8:30 pagi) hingga implementation start (25 Mei 3:00 pagi). Trail bersih untuk handover NOC shift pagi.

Itu sahaja. Terima kasih banyak — really clean run. Saya akan email senior management ringkasan ni. Selamat pagi.

Sama-sama Puan Siti Nur. Saya akan menghantar template ringkasan dengan link snapshot, evidence dan audit trail ke emel Puan dalam beberapa minit. Selamat pagi, dan tahniah atas pelaksanaan yang teratur.
